title: Enquiries dashboard: profile completion + clearer access denied + save profile mutation

requirements.summary: Show a Complete Profile form on the enquiries dashboard when the authenticated caller has no profile or an empty/whitespace email, then save and refresh authorization/enquiries.
acceptanceCriteria: If the user is logged in and getCallerUserProfile returns null or an email that is empty/whitespace, the page shows a profile form instead of the generic "Access Denied" message.
Submitting the profile form persists the profile via the backend and triggers a refresh of admin/profile/enquiries queries.
After saving a profile email matching Advnitin1404@gmail.com (case-insensitive), the enquiries list loads without requiring a hard refresh.

file_operations.description: Add a 'Complete Profile' UI state that appears when the caller is authenticated but userProfile is null or userProfile.email is empty/whitespace; use shadcn-ui (e.g., Card/Button/Input/Label) components to compose the form without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui. Wire the form submit to the saveCallerUserProfile mutation (REQ-4) and, on success, re-check admin status/profile and load enquiries automatically. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the enquiries dashboard Access Denied state self-diagnostic by showing isCallerAdmin result and the saved profile email (or not set).
acceptanceCriteria: When access is denied, the UI displays the admin-check result (admin vs not admin) and the currently loaded profile email value (or 'not set').
All user-facing text is in English and does not expose sensitive implementation details beyond the above status.

file_operations.description: Enhance the unauthorized UI to display (a) whether isCallerAdmin is true/false and (b) the currently loaded userProfile.email (normalized display not required) or 'not set'; keep messaging in English and limit details to these two diagnostics. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create a React Query mutation hook for saveCallerUserProfile and use it from the enquiries dashboard profile form, invalidating related queries on success.
acceptanceCriteria: A new mutation exists for saveCallerUserProfile and is used by the enquiries dashboard to persist name/email.
On success, relevant cached queries (currentUserProfile, isCallerAdmin, enquiries) are invalidated/refetched so the UI updates immediately.

file_operations.description: Add and export a React Query mutation hook (e.g., useSaveCallerUserProfile) that calls actor.saveCallerUserProfile(profile) and, on success, invalidates/refetches cached queries for currentUserProfile, isCallerAdmin, and enquiries so the admin dashboard updates immediately. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the new saveCallerUserProfile mutation hook from the 'Complete Profile' form; ensure submit disables while pending, shows errors via existing toast pattern, and triggers immediate UI refresh by relying on the mutation's query invalidation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
